doc: bsv-low #834 (FIX-834): the courier subrequests of the index janitor's pass (POST /admin/complete-proofs, the tick's run_pot_maintenance and retire pass on paced counters) over 40 proofless pot BEEFs with the couriers sunk to a loopback stand-in that answers WoC 429 and every other courier 404 (tools/lane-834/janitor_pacing_budget_ci.mjs, make ci-d1-budget, run on the #831 cell's overlay after the #837 cell). total = every GET the stand-in saw; paced = the pass's own count of the asks its pacer let go; since FIX-834-MERGE they are equal (the retire pass's #602 conflict pass, its looks and the rebroadcast backstop ask through the same pacer). WoC is bounded by the back-off (3), Bitails by its could-not-look cap of 3 PER QUESTION (the proof ladder's and, with the #837 cell's JOINs as conflict candidates, the conflict pass's per-output spend: 6), Arcade by the fixture's 40 candidates (one ask each); total is the measured figure plus 2. Raise one only with a new measurement and its reason. Unpaced (00a5e613) the same pass asks every rung on every candidate: 40 + 40 + 40 = 120 by the ladder's shape (reasoned, not run in the tier). On 45b83a32 (the merged main, the conflict pass unpaced): pass 1 total 70, paced 46, WoC 6, Bitails 24; pass 2 total 67, WoC 3, Bitails 24. COURIER-RUNG-FOLD (bsv-low #868, 2026-10-24): the retire overlay runs PROOF_SOURCES with bananablocks since #868 (without it no absence is read and the #831 cell's ghost pots never end), so BananaBlocks is now the spend ladder's capable rung: every one of its asks in both passes is `/api/v1/txo/{txid}/{vout}/spend` (the cell prints them by route), the retire pass's #602 conflict pass reading the #837 cell's stranger JOINs' outputs, rotating through them, inside that pass's own 24-call fetcher budget and the pacer's 64 a pass; zero are the presence rung `/api/v1/tx/{txid}` (no candidate here reaches an absence look). Before #868 those reads found no capable rung (WoC backed off, pruned Bitails capped) and were skipped: the pass was blind there, not cheaper. The ceilings move to the measurement, not bound: these are reads the conflict pass needs, already bounded by its fetcher budget.
